name: Harbor Lights (Broken)
description: A deliberately non-conformant twin of Harbor Lights: the key is behind the door it opens, the lamp runs dry before the skiff, and the declared encounter names a missing participant.
scene_description: A cold pier at the edge of the harbor. A single lamp burns in the lighthouse.
scene_atmosphere: Salt wind, low fog, and a lamp already nearly dry.
narrative_directive: The lamp is nearly out and the key is not where it should be.

world_effect.value: The lamp gutters out and the skiff slips away into the dark.

pier.name: Pier
pier.description: Weathered planks end at a locked lighthouse door.

lighthouse.name: Lighthouse
lighthouse.description: The lamp room. The key hangs inside, behind the locked door.

skiff.name: Skiff
skiff.description: A small boat knocking against the lighthouse stair.

lighthouse door.name: Lighthouse Door
lighthouse door.description: A salt-swollen door with a brass lock.

skiff key.name: Skiff Key
skiff key.description: A brass key on a tarred cord, hanging just inside the lighthouse.
